title: Report: Vikings want second interview with five GM candidates

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Vikings want second interview with five GM candidates
sources.description: Vikings owner Mark Wilf said on Tuesday that the team is ready to move on to a second round of General Manager interviews and the team has reportedly picked five candidates to continue in the search process.
